description: This file implements the RenderFrame class, which is responsible for rendering a video frame in a media playback context. It interacts with GStreamer elements to control video sink properties and send rendering events.

classes.name: RenderFrame
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering a video frame by interacting with GStreamer video sink elements.

methods.name: RenderFrame
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RenderFrame with the given context and wrappers.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the rendering operation by configuring the video sink and sending a step event.
